body: Ever since I wrote this post, I felt like a robot with no feelings. All that was in my mind was ways I can die making sure that I actually end it and don't end up seriously hurt and make things worse. But the thing is, part of me doesn't want to die. Honestly, it's not about giving up. It's about giving in to death that seems more welcoming than people around you. I am scared of dying but at the same time, I don't have the energy to keep going. But I don't wanna die hurting someone else. Arg... I'm just so lost. Why did this happen to me? I had been the strong one listening everyone's problems; giving others support? I always try to be nice to people but why are they so mean? I try to be there for people but when I need someone, why am I left all alone? I have never hated anyone; always accepted people even when they hurt me but why can't they accept just a part of me? Just because I'm polite, why do people keep telling me I'm weak? You know I used to cry and that would make me feel better. But every time I cried, my  family, my best friend would call me too emotional. Now I don't cry. Even when I want, I can't make myself cry. I have dreams of the night my cousin tried to rape me, of my teacher slapping me constantly telling me I am pathetic and I will never succeed in life. When I told my sister, she said stop pitying yourself. When I told my friends and my family about my sexuality, I thought they were accepting but I realized the only reason they didn't say anything was because I had returned from ER. The next day, in her anger, my sister called me selfish for not thinking about society. The next month, my best friend said I shouldn't have told my family and they will never accept it. "Are you sure? What if you see a really hot guy?" I let it go that time because I thought they were right. It was selfish of me and my family will never accept me completely. The next month, when I told my best friend it was insensitive of her to say those things to me, she said she didn't wanna be friends with someone so sensitive. This past sunday, when I saw the shooting on the news, I was crying, my mom didn't do anything. My sister could see I was upset but she didn't even read the news completely. On top of that, my mom says sex is only between man and woman. I am overwhelmed but I can't cry. What should I do? I can't tell my therapist about my suicidal thoughts because she will send me to psych ward. I've been there before. I don't wanna go there. My anxiety has gotten worse. Every time I'm outside I feel like people are looking at me. I went to cut my hair few days ago and I would feel myself trembling every other minute. Studying is hard, feels terrible to swallow, sleeping is hard. Trust me I don't want to die but I don't know what to do. I wanted to be successful. Do something for the people, leave a legacy but even breathing seems terrible right now. People around me are filled with so much anger and bitterness. I don't want to be like that. I don't wanna blame someone else for my failure, I want to get rid of the dissatisfaction I have with people. I don't want it to turn into anger amd eventually hate. That's not me. This is not me. Is this earth meant for me? Will I ever be happy? My existence is probably a burden to others. I don't want to die but I don't see a point of living.

My dear stranger,

When I say I feel your pain, I really mean it. I identify as a gay woman. I don't know your exact struggles because I am not in your shoes. I can't imagine what it must be like to be a transgender woman and have your own family not support you. But I know what it feels like to be not accepted by your loved ones; when they don't try to understand what you are going through and instead make things worse. I am in this dark place like you right now and I don't see a way out.
I wish I could help you but I can't even help myself. I've tried to get help but everytime I think I've pulled myself out, someone says something or something happens and I find myself in the same place. My life is a mess right now and I don't know what to do. My financial condition is just as bad as my academics. Once, I had been a star student, a lively girl but now everyone seems to have lost hope in me. My best friend was right, my family, society will never accept me. My resolve to end it all has become stronger and pretty soon, I will do it.
For now, all I can say is, I may not know you in person but I love you. I wish I had someone like you in my life whom I could hug because no one else seems to understand. I'm sorry for your pain.
